subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Produzir artigos de opinião, tendo em vista o contexto de produção dado, a defesa de um ponto de vista, utilizando argumentos e contra-argumentos e articuladores de coesão que marquem relações de oposição, contraste, exemplificação, ênfase.

components.description_pt: Defender ponto de vista claro em artigo de opinião
components.description_en: Defend a clear point of view in an opinion article
components.cc_component_description: State a clear opinion or claim at the opening of an opinion piece

components.description_pt: Usar argumentos e contraargumentos para apoiar posição em artigo de opinião
components.description_en: Use arguments and counterarguments to support a position in an opinion article
components.cc_component_description: Support or challenge an opinion, premise, or interpretation using reasoning

components.description_pt: Aplicar conectivos coesivos sinalizando oposição, contraste, exemplificação ou ênfase
components.description_en: Apply cohesive connectors signaling opposition, contrast, exemplification, or emphasis
components.cc_component_description: Use transition words signaling contrast such as however and although correctly

components.description_pt: Produzir artigo de opinião adaptado ao seu contexto específico de produção
components.description_en: Produce an opinion article adapted to its specific production context
components.cc_component_description: Organize an opinion piece with an introduction, supporting reasons, and a concluding statement

cc_matches.description: Introduce the topic or text they are writing about, state an opinion, and create an organizational structure that lists reasons.
Write opinion pieces on topics or texts, supporting a point of view with reasons.

Multilingual learners will…
* __Generate questions about different perspectives__
* Support __or challenge__ an opinion, __premise, or interpretation__
* Clarify and elaborate ideas based on feedback
* __Evaluate changes in thinking, identifying trade-offs__
* Refine __claims and reasoning based on new information or evidence__

Acquire and use accurately grade-appropriate general academic and domain-specific words and phrases, including those that signal contrast, addition, and other logical relationships (e.g., however, although, nevertheless, similarly, moreover, in addition).
